args.name: Assess feasibility of a bounded hazelnut food test
args.function: Provide a learnable physical procedure to investigate one specific dietary property of my owned hazelnut, such as a defined toxic constituent or preparation requirement. Specify exactly what a result could and could not establish. If no supported test exists, state that limitation rather than substituting visible-state observation or mass comparison for safety evidence.
args.conditions: I own one uneaten hazelnut, item-11-lin-103. Source and sample observation supplied no dietary measurements. The available drying and mass-comparison procedures do not establish toxicity or nutritional suitability. I will not eat the sample as a safety test.
args.inputs: Owned hazelnut sample. Identify any reagents, tools, reference materials or other prerequisites; their availability is unknown.
args.costs: Specify learning time, energy, sample consumption, equipment requirements and hazards before any trial. Do not automatically start testing.
args.effects: A reusable bounded test contract if physically supported, or an explicit account of what cannot currently be measured and what is missing. No inferred edibility, treatment success, nutrition or health improvement.

candidates.function: Assess, assemble, test, use, inspect or dismantle a lever comparator: your branch beam across a stone fulcrum, a fixed seat and your own sliding reference piece. Readings give sample mass as a fraction of the reference and before/after ratios, as intervals.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. Checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate; no refund.
candidates.effects: Assumed: a branch is a uniform 1.1 m beam laid at its midpoint; positions are fractions of the half-beam from the fulcrum (+ toward the reference), read to 0.02; the seat is at -0.9. A reading slides the reference until the beam tips: torques of the actual masses against stiction 0.005 m x mass on the fulcrum, so outward and inward tips bracket a null range. A test (3+ empty and 3+ loaded readings of one sample, both directions each) passes if each set repeats within 0.04 and closes; a new test replaces it. compare on a tested comparator: an empty check, 3+ loaded readings of one sample (both directions) and a closing empty check within 0.04 of the test give an endpoint: sample/reference = (null - empty null)/0.9 as an interval. A later endpoint of the same sample (followed through pickup, cutting or exposure) and reference gives after/before: decrease or increase only if it excludes 1, else inconclusive; a wet stone or flint reference adds 1%, other wet references are inconclusive. Rain voids a test; a fulcrum losing firm ground damages it. Parts keep their ids and return on dismantle. No grams, water, safety or reward.

candidates.function: Take a small sample and equal reference from your own food; split or slice the sample with your stone or flint edge onto a clean support in actual weather; weigh both on your tested beam comparator; tend; stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds. start: sourceItemId, your unspoiled whole berry or root stack; sampleQuantity 0.1-1 (default 0.1; over twice it must remain); durationRounds, exposure window (default 10); 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare: preparation; toolId, your carried whole stone or flint unit with a usable edge; supportId, your clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic item (a whole unit per 0.04 covered) laid at location in reach on firm clear ground, or a food surface in reach; 1 round, 0.5. measure: measurementDeviceId, your tested beam-mass-comparator in reach, weighs the sample and the reference; 1 round, 0.2 per item. tend: in reach; location moves your support and pieces; 1 round, 0.2. stop: 1 round, 0. Checks precede any charge; travel, gathering and comparator work cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates sample and reference with tenths, decay, harvest time, origin and the world water record (assumed root 0.75, berry 0.85); both stay whole, carried, reserved. Prepare cuts the sample, taken as a 1000 kg/m3 sphere, into 2 halves or slabs of at most 5 mm laid cut face up (at least 0.04 per unit); no mass, wear or offcut; opening damage 1.1. Each round only lying cut faces exchange water: rate h/1200 x (saturation vapour density at the face - humidity x that of the air), h = 10 x (1 + 0.5 wind), face temperature from the heat balance with latent heat 2.45 MJ/kg, bounded by free water above the humidity equilibrium within 0.33 mm; rain adds 0.01 x rain x area; dry matter and nutrition stay. A weighing slides the reference both ways: mass as a reference fraction at 0.02 resolution against the tested tare; repeats give after/before and reference-adjusted intervals, a change only if 1 is excluded, else unresolved. No water content is shown. The window ends completed (weighed) or indeterminate; spoilage, removal, stop or death end it early, releasing the reference once; pieces and support stay. No preservation, safety or reward.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

candidates.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.
